description: email.rs: HeaderForm is used in validate_header_form error messages via format\!("{form:?}", ...) (lines 232, 237, 244, 250) — the {:?} Debug format produces Rust identifier names like 'AsAddresses' rather than JMAP wire strings like 'asAddresses'. These error messages are returned to the client as JmapError::invalid_arguments descriptions. A client parsing the error to understand which form they used incorrectly sees 'AsAddresses' (Rust) not 'asAddresses' (JMAP spec term). The fix: impl Display for HeaderForm returning the JMAP wire-format name (matching RFC 8621 §4.1.3), then use {form} in the format strings. This is not a correctness bug — the error is reported — but the message is misleading to JMAP clients and the {form:?} form signals missing Display is intentional when it is not.
title: HeaderForm lacks Display — debug format leaks into user-visible error messages
